name: omnibridge/doctrine
description: omnibase's persistence on Doctrine, and the storage glue of omnibase sites, framework-free: Doctrine reading the structure described outside of it (omnisense/omnibridge's schema), the naming strategy, the UTC date types, an entity manager built with them; behind the core's contracts, the compiler of the finder language, the statements of the backend-only queries and the mapping. It declares no repository: the core's repositories are the same on every persistence. The Doctrine classes a host's configuration names are declared under the core's own namespace.

suggest.omnisense/omnibase: The core this package is the Doctrine persistence of (^7.0)
